notes.title: 25/10/2024 Small bug fixes
notes.content:
Just a few small bug fixes this week! But keep your eyes peeled for upcoming updates, including the release of endless mode and legendary mode, and the release of the first expansion pack, the Dwarven Halls!

- Fixed bug where playing offline would sometimes cause crashes
- Fixed bug with the Jester encounter ending early
- Fixed bug with the vault puzzle getting stuck in certain scenarios
